set.body:
Independent review of HRF/design identity repair 3d513f14e9399d37bd87363c6d36e98d3d62c614 (Fray #153, issue bd-01M3SC5BYS29CR1TVS2JCVZ3Y8) found a remaining provenance boundary outside that candidate's exact 21 paths.

modules/design/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/fmri/design/hrf/KernelBasis.scala:57-59: KernelBasisProvenance.canonical uses kernel-basis/v1 and interpolates chart lower/upper bounds, horizonSeconds, fineStepSeconds and tolerance as Doubles. Integral and exponent rendering remains platform-dependent (24.0 vs 24; E vs e).

modules/fit/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/fmri/fit/profile/ConditionProfileFit.scala:50-52: ConditionProfileProvenance.canonical uses condition-profile/v1 and interpolates noiseVariance, plus case-class budget rendering. Its construction at lines64-66 embeds policy.basis.provenance.canonical, propagating the kernel identity difference.

Bounded acceptance: reproduce the old JVM/JS wire difference, replace numeric/case-class identity rendering with explicit tagged fields and exact Double bits, use unambiguous framing for user strings, bump affected identity versions, and audit opaque persisted/consumer contracts. Add shared literal goldens covering integral/exponent values, signed zero, nested kernel provenance, and one-bit distinctions, plus JVM and JS checks. Keep actual kernel/SVD/fit arithmetic unchanged and do not claim numerical bit parity of separately computed kernels. Old v1 provenance must not be rewritten or silently rebound.

This is a verified source finding; no implementation or numerical qualification is completed. The reviewed structural-column v2 candidate remains explicitly bounded and does not repair this separate kernel/profile provenance format.
set.title: Kernel and condition-profile provenance: exact cross-platform numeric identity
